dct_title_s: Lake Nokomis Improvement Plan, January 1911, Minneapolis Park Board, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: Lantern slide image of a map of Lake Nokomis park. Suggestive plan for the improvement of Lake Nokomis as a reservoir for maintaining Minnehaha Falls, January 1911.
